title: Kita-Entwicklung – Ansätze und Konzepte für Organisationsentwicklung in der frühen Bildung
summary: How can organizational development lead to improved daycare quality? The volume presents two out of four expertise developed in the "Forum KITA Development" project that deal with this question. The results show how kindergarten development can draw on findings from organizational psychology. Of particular importance is the actions of the day-care centre management in cooperation with other actors.
